Weak Point Read.name: Weak Point Read
Weak Point Read.description: The user studies a target through the sights for a breath and finds the gap: a costume seam, a bare joint, a support item's power cell. The shot that follows ignores armor and shields and deals piercing damage (bludgeoning damage from rubber rounds), and a hit on a support item shuts it down until it is repaired. Stamina: brief.
